DataDirUnavailable: Folio can't find a place to keep its data. Restart Folio. If this keeps happening, send the error details to the developer.
InvalidArgument: Something went wrong inside Folio. Restart Folio. If this keeps happening, send the error details to the developer.
Window: That window action didn't work. Restart Folio.
Transport: This window can't reach the rest of Folio. Restart Folio.
NoLibrary: No library is open. Create a library or open one first.
NotALibrary: This folder isn't a Folio library. Choose another folder, or create a new library here.
AlreadyALibrary: This folder is already a Folio library, or is inside one. Open that library instead, or choose another folder.
NewerFormat: A newer version of Folio created this library. Update Folio to open it.
ReadOnly: A newer version of Folio saved some of this library's settings, so tags and course details can't be changed for now. Update Folio to change them.
NotFound: This item isn't here anymore. It may have just been moved, renamed or deleted.
AlreadyExists: This name is already in use. Upper and lower case count as the same. Try another name.
InvalidMove: Can't move this here. A folder can't go inside itself or one of its subfolders, and semester folders can be renamed but not moved.
NameTooLong: This name is too long. Shorten it and try again.
NameInvalidCharacter: This name has characters that can't be used, such as \ / : * ? " < > | or a line break. Remove them and try again.
NameTrailingDotOrSpace: Names can't end with a dot or a space.
NameReserved: Windows or Folio reserves this name (for example CON, NUL or .folio). Try another name.
PathTooLong: The path is too long for Windows. Use a shorter name or fewer nested folders.
InUse: Another app is using this file. Close it in that app, then try again.
AccessDenied: Windows denied access to this file or folder. Check its permissions, then try again.
DiskFull: The disk is full. Free up some space, then try again.
NotRecyclable: Folio couldn't move this to the Recycle Bin, so it's still where it was. The drive may not have a Recycle Bin, or the path is too long for it. Folio never deletes files for good.
NotLocal: This file is only in the cloud and isn't downloaded to this computer. Open it in its own app to download it, then try again.
NoThumbnail: Windows can't make a preview of this file. Open it in its own app instead.
FileSystem: Something went wrong while reading or writing files. Try again. If this keeps happening, send the error details to the developer.
QueryTooLong: This search is too long. Shorten it and try again.
ChoiceExpired: This selection has expired. Choose or drop the items again.
Blocked: To keep you safe, Folio doesn't run programs or scripts. You can show this file in File Explorer and decide there whether to open it.
Busy: Folio is rebuilding the search index, so changes are paused. Try again when it's done.
Internal: Something went wrong inside Folio. Restart Folio. If this keeps happening, send the error details to the developer.
